basis: Cytokinin-activating enzyme at the tip of shoot, inflorescence, branch and spikelet meristems (in situ) and needed for meristem size (Kurakawa et al. 2007 Nature); Zong 2022 used it to call its meristem clusters (inferred, paper not readable).

Class I KNOX; in situ in indeterminate meristems (SAM, IM, BM, SM) and off in lateral organ primordia (Sato et al. 1996 PNAS). Also in stem/rachis ground tissue, and Jing 2026 portal lists it for "spikelet supporting cells": check axis cells.

ALOG regulator; in situ high in IM and BM, low in SM, and controls the IM/BM-to-SM transition (Yoshida et al. 2013 PNAS). Added from literature to fill the IM gap; not named by either reviewed dataset. The characterized-marker survey (same Yoshida 2013 in situ) also assigns it to BM; same study, so no raise.

Auxin influx carrier; enriched in Zong 2022 BM subclusters (inferred) and osaux1 has fewer branches and spikelets (Zong 2022). Function supports a BM role, not BM-specific expression; also expressed in roots. Not LAX1 (Os01g0831000).

SEP-like MADS; in situ in BM and SM, later in rudimentary glume and sterile lemma; mutant alters inflorescence branching and spikelet identity (Kobayashi et al. 2010 Plant Cell Physiol; Gao et al. 2010 Plant Physiol). Not SM-specific (also BM).

WOX9-clade homeobox (DWARF TILLER1; Wang et al. 2014 PLoS Genet); enriched in the Zong 2022 FM subcluster (inferred), and dwt1 alters FM activity and palea specification (Zong 2022). Cell-resolution localization in the panicle not confirmed; also acts in tiller growth. Jing 2026 curated Floral_primodium marker (ZH11 ZH01G29460), but Jing copied its panicle markers from Zong 2022, so not independent: kept medium.
CLE peptide gene that acts in floral meristem maintenance (Suzaki et al. 2009 PLoS Genet); shown in a Zong 2022 spikelet figure (inferred). Cell-resolution localization not checked.

E-class SEP MADS; enriched in the Zong 2022 FM subcluster (inferred). Conflict: in Wang 2025 SP8 nuclei it is DE in four clusters (Filament, Epidermis, Stigmata, Ovary wall), so it marks inner floral organs broadly, not FM.

YABBY; in situ in lateral organ primordia (rudimentary glume, sterile lemma, lemma, palea) and off in meristems, mutant has meristem/spikelet defects (Tanaka et al. 2012 Plant Cell). Zong 2022 "OsYAB1 (TOB1)" is ambiguous; Jing 2026 portal lists TOB1 for spikelet primordia and sterile lemma.

ALOG protein; in situ in sterile lemma (empty glume) primordia and g1 converts the sterile lemma to lemma (Yoshida et al. 2009 PNAS). Added from literature for the rg/sl label of Zong 2022 (subcluster 9).

SEP-like MADS; in situ in SM/early FM, then lemma and palea; mutant gives leafy hulls (Jeon et al. 2000 Plant Cell; Prasad et al. 2005 Plant J). Marks lemma and palea alike: separate palea with REP1/OsMADS6. Zong 2022 lemma marker (inferred).
Same gene as the Lemma row: in situ in both lemma and palea (Prasad et al. 2005 Plant J). Use with REP1 to call palea.

CYC/TB1-type TCP; in situ in early palea primordia and rep1 has a lemma-like reduced palea (Yuan et al. 2009 Plant Physiol). Later also in stamens and vasculature. Not the cysteine protease "REP1" Os01g0907600, and not RepA LOC_Os11g14900. MSU-RAP pair from Oryzabase (UniProt entry for Os09g0410500 lacks the MSU ID).

AGL6-like MADS; in situ in FM, then the marginal region of the palea, lodicules, carpel and ovule; mutant changes palea and lodicule identity (Ohmori et al. 2009 Plant Cell; Li et al. 2011 Plant Cell). Not palea-specific. Zong 2022 floret subcluster 7 (inferred).

AP3-like B-class MADS; in situ in lodicule and stamen primordia, spw1 converts lodicules to palea-like organs and stamens to carpels (Nagasawa et al. 2003 Development). Conflict: in Wang 2025 it is DE in "Epidermis" and "Filament", not in the "Lodicule" cluster.
PI-like B-class MADS needed mainly for lodicule identity (Yao et al. 2008 Plant Cell Physiol). Wang 2025 DE in "Epidermis" and "Filament" (B-class organs relabelled), not "Lodicule". Also in stamens.
PI-like B-class MADS for lodicule and stamen identity (Yao et al. 2008 Plant Cell Physiol). Wang 2025 DE in "Filament". Also in stamens.

AG-like C-class MADS; in situ in stamen and carpel primordia, mutant converts stamens to lodicule-like organs (Yamaguchi et al. 2006 Plant Cell). Added from literature; not in the Wang 2025 SP8 DE list. Also carpel.

AG-like C-class MADS acting in stamen and carpel and in FM determinacy (Yamaguchi et al. 2006 Plant Cell). Wang 2025 SP8 DE in "Stigmata" (relabelled carpel). Also stamen. Jing 2026 curated Floral_primodium marker (sp6-sp8; ZH11 ZH05G07680), i.e. FM plus carpel/ovule primordia, not a carpel cluster: kept medium.

YABBY carpel-identity gene; in situ in carpel primordia and dl turns carpels into stamens (Yamaguchi et al. 2004 Plant Cell). Wang 2025 SP8 DE in "Stigmata" (lfc 2.0). Also in leaf and lemma midrib: flag-leaf contamination can express it.

D-class MADS; in situ in ovule primordia and integuments, mutant loses ovule identity (Lopez-Dee et al. 1999 Dev Genet; Dreni et al. 2007 Plant J). Wang 2025 used it as the SP6 "stigma" in situ probe and it is DE in SP8 "Stigmata". Two independent validations. Not in the Zong 2022 S2-1 gene list (too early). Jing 2026 curated Floral_primodium marker (ZH11 ZH12G07420); already high.
Senescence S40 family; in situ pattern looks ovule-like (Wang 2025 Fig 5b, ED Fig 2g), but its cluster ("Ovule", rejected) is photosynthetic. Use only with OsMADS13.

bHLH required for tapetum degeneration, tapetum-preferential expression (Li et al. 2006 Plant Cell); DE in Wang 2025 Tapetum (lfc 1.7). Jing 2026 (independent third study) also uses it as a curated Tapetum marker in snRNA from all 6 stamen samples and cell-segmented stamen Stereo-seq (ZH11 ZH02G01740); already high.

bHLH promoting tapetal programmed cell death, expressed in tapetum (Niu et al. 2013 Nat Commun); DE in Wang 2025 Tapetum (lfc 1.6). Jing 2026 curated Tapetum marker (snRNA + cell-segmented Stereo-seq; ZH11 ZH04G27240); already high.

Tapetum lipid transfer protein needed for pollen exine and orbicules (Zhang et al. 2010 Plant Physiol); DE in Wang 2025 Tapetum (lfc 3.4). Jing 2026 portal lists it for "stamen residue". Jing 2026 uses it in Stereo-seq to flag anther residue (Stamen_residue) in pistil samples (ZH11 ZH11G20240); already high.

Rice tapetum-specific gene; promoter active in tapetum and antisense gives male sterility (Luo et al. 2006 Plant Mol Biol); DE in Wang 2025 Tapetum (lfc 3.6). Literature tapetum localization plus single-cell enrichment raised confidence medium to high.

Tapetum BURP protein targeted to Ubisch bodies, needed for pollen (Wang et al. 2003 PNAS); DE in Wang 2025 Tapetum (lfc 2.4). Literature tapetum localization plus single-cell enrichment raised confidence medium to high.
Uncharacterized (Oryzabase "C18 hydroxylase" annotation, no symbol); in situ in the anther locule ring at SP6 and SP8 and top Tapetum DE gene (Wang 2025).

Germline-specific Argonaute; in situ in archesporial cells and PMCs, mel1 arrests meiosis (Nonomura et al. 2007 Plant Cell). Added from literature: Wang 2025 "Pollen mother cell" DE has no meiosis genes.
Meiosis-specific coiled-coil protein for homolog pairing, expressed in PMCs (Nonomura et al. 2004 Plant Cell). Added from literature; not in the Wang 2025 PMC DE list.
Uncharacterized (Oryzabase symbols conflict: SPO11-5/UBP13); in situ dots inside anther locules (Wang 2025 Fig 1f) for "Pollen mother cell"; meiocyte vs microspore not resolved.
Serine carboxypeptidase; in situ inside locules at SP6 and top SP8 "Pollen mother cell" DE gene (Wang 2025); that cluster lacks meiosis genes, so the type may be locule cells generally.

Very-long-chain aldehyde decarbonylase for anther cuticular wax, in situ in anther epidermis (Jung et al. 2006 Plant Cell); outer-layer in situ and Epidermis DE (lfc 2.2) in Wang 2025. Biased to anther epidermis. Two independent validations raised confidence medium to high. Wang 2025 DE also in "Filament". Jing 2026 curated marker of the spatially placed anther Epidermis (cell-segmented Stereo-seq; ZH11 ZH10G15260), and also of spikelet "Pistil_identity_cell", which is therefore read as epidermis; already high.

HD-ZIP IV (GL2-type) expressed in the outermost cell layer (protoderm/L1) from embryo to shoot apex (Ito et al. 2002 Plant J). Zong 2022 meristem-epidermis subcluster was called from "ROC genes" (which ROC loci is unconfirmed).
GDSL lipase (uncharacterized); outer-layer in situ at SP3, SP4 and SP6 (Wang 2025 ED Fig 8g).
Non-specific lipid transfer protein 1; epidermis in situ in the shoot apex (Wang 2025 ED Fig 2e) and panicle Epidermis DE (lfc 3.0).

G2/M cyclin; same row as rice_root.tsv. Screen meristem and FM clusters with it before naming them (neither panicle dataset removed cycling cells). Jing 2026 lists it for Spikelet_primordia and Palea, both read here as proliferation-driven labels.
Plant-specific B-type CDK of G2/M; same row as rice_root.tsv. Jing 2026 Spikelet_primordia marker (with CDKB1;1, CYCA2;1, KCH1), read as a proliferation state.
DNA sliding clamp of replication; same row as rice_root.tsv. Jing 2026 marker of Steril_lemma-Rudimentary_glume (with OsRPA1): screen that label for S phase.
ABC transporter polarly localized to the tapetal plasma membrane facing the locule; needed for exine (Zhao 2015 Plant Physiol); Jing 2026 curated Tapetum marker. ZH11 ZH06G23320.

Chlorophyll a/b-binding (LHCB6); Jing 2026 'Our spatial transcriptome data' marker of Endothecium in cell-segmented stamen Stereo-seq (counts as in situ). Photosynthesis gene: use only inside anther clusters. ZH11 ZH04G16710.

LHCB; Jing 2026 curated marker of Endothecium and of Ovary_wall/Ovary_wall_2 (cites a circadian paper, no tissue claim). Marks any chlorenchyma; anther-only use. Portal symbol 'CAB2R' is wrong for this chr9 locus (CAB2R is Os01g0600900). ZH11 ZH09G07540.
PSI antenna; Jing 2026 curated Endothecium marker (snRNA). Photosynthesis; anther-only use. ZH11 ZH08G19490.

bZIP preferentially expressed in stamens, required for tapetum development and endothecium thickening (Chen 2018 Plant Physiol); Jing 2026 curated Middle_layer marker. Function is not middle-layer specific. ZH11 ZH09G15940.

Secreted fasciclin specifically expressed in male reproductive cells; mtr1 defective microspores and tapetum (Tan 2012 Dev Cell). Jing 2026 lists it for Microspore, Meiotic_cell and sp8 Stamen: male germline marker, not microspore-only. Not the chr7 'MTR1' (Os07g0694600). ZH11 ZH02G18710.

Major CHG methyltransferase in rice meiocytes (Li 2024 Genome Biol); Jing 2026 curated marker of 'Microscope_mother_cell' (=microspore mother cell). Also listed for spikelet Cryptic_bract, so not germline-exclusive. Oryzabase symbol is CMT2/CMT3a, UniProt CMT3. ZH11 ZH10G00280.

CDC20 needed for meiotic chromosome segregation (Lin 2022 Plant Physiol); Jing 2026 MMC marker. G2/M gene: also marks mitotic cells, use only with a germline marker. ZH11 ZH04G27290. Placed under Dividing_cells (state) instead of Meiocyte: kind=state.
CDC20 (G2/M; Lin 2022 Plant Physiol); Jing 2026 lists it for 'Microscope_mother_cell'. State marker. ZH11 ZH02G32250.
UDP-glucose pyrophosphorylase for callose during pollen development (Wang 2020 JXB, cited by Jing); Jing 2026 Meiotic_cell marker (snRNA, one sample). Housekeeping-like metabolism. ZH11 ZH09G20540.
Sperm-cell fusogen; osgcs1 fails fertilization (Honma 2020 Commun Biol); Jing 2026 curated Mature_pollen marker (S12 only). ZH11 ZH05G11000.
Sucrose-phosphate synthase; Jing 2026 marker_resource 'in-situ validation' for Mature_pollen (one of 4 in situ genes atlas-wide; figure not seen). ZH11 ZH01G47340.
Pectate lyase-like; Jing 2026 'in-situ validation' for Mature_pollen (figure not seen). ZH11 ZH06G03780.
NIMA-related kinase preferentially expressed in mature pollen (Fujii 2009 PCP) and Jing 2026 Mature_pollen marker (two studies). ZH11 ZH07G05230.
K+ transporter preferentially expressed in anthers and husks, needed for pollen wall (Li 2022 PCP); Jing 2026 Mature_pollen marker. ZH11 ZH08G24230.
GEX1 ortholog (gamete nuclear fusion; Yabe 2022 Plants); Jing 2026 Mature_pollen marker. Portal gives no symbol; symbol from Jing's cited DOI + Oryzabase GEX1 (same chr9 position). ZH11 ZH09G12600.
GEX3 (Bao 2024 Planta, anther development); Jing 2026 Mature_pollen marker. Portal gives no symbol; symbol inferred from cited DOI + Oryzabase GEX3 at the same chr1 position. ZH11 ZH01G25350.
JA-Ile synthetase, in situ/GUS in lodicules and anthers, needed for dehiscence (Xiao 2014 PMB); Jing 2026 marker of 'Vascular_bundle-Connective_tissue'. Not cell-type specific. ZH11 ZH05G32000.
Pectin methylesterase; Style marker from Li 2023 Dev Cell pistil snRNA, re-used by Jing 2026 (not independent). ZH11 ZH08G08310.
GDSL lipase; Li 2023 Dev Cell marker re-used by Jing 2026 for Style_epidermis and Ovary_wall_epidermis (carpel epidermis). ZH11 ZH01G33800.
Stress-responsive NAC; Jing 2026 spatial marker of Ovary_wall_1 (square bins). Stress gene, so a state risk; use with CAB-type genes and position. ZH11 ZH01G44900.

CLE (CLV3-like) peptide; transcripts at the apex of all aerial meristems; fon2 enlarges the FM (Suzaki 2006 PCP); Jing 2026 curated Floral_primodium marker. Marks the stem-cell apex of IM/BM/SM too, so lowered high to medium for FM. ZH11 ZH11G21130.
AP2/ERF for SM-to-FM transition; reported at the rudimentary-glume axil (Zhu 2003 BMC Plant Biol; location not re-read). Jing 2026 curated Cryptic_bract marker. ZH11 ZH07G29220.
Class I KNOX; Jing 2026 curated marker (with OSH1) of 'Spikelet/Pistil_supporting_cell', read here as axis/receptacle ground tissue. ZH11 ZH07G02070.
KNOX; Ds insertion gives bract outgrowth (Park 2007 Planta); Jing 2026 Bract_primordia marker (spatial label). ZH11 ZH01G14710.
Plastochron timekeeper (Miyoshi 2004 PNAS); pla1 panicle bracts grow out. Jing 2026 Bract_primordia marker (literature). ZH11 ZH10G11230.
MEI2-like (Kawakatsu 2006 Plant Cell); Jing 2026 Bract_primordia marker. ZH11 ZH01G46460.
Jing 2026 spatial marker of Inflorescence_meristem_1 (0.1 mm panicle; square bins). ZH11 ZH04G31960.

AP2 needed for abscission-zone formation (Zhou 2012 Plant Cell). Jing 2026 spatial marker of 'Inflorescence_meristem_2', a label rejected here (grows to 2,886 nuclei at 3-5 mm, after IM abortion); flag, do not use as IM marker. ZH11 ZH04G31570.

bHLH (BA1 ortholog) needed for axillary meristem formation in the panicle; in situ in 1-3 cell layers at the boundary between the IM and new branch/spikelet AMs, lax1 lacks lateral spikelets and branches (Komatsu et al. 2003 PNAS). Marks the AM boundary, not the BM body, so medium. From the characterized-marker survey.

HD-Zip TF; in situ onset in early provascular cells of leaf and inflorescence primordia, ectopic expression accelerates procambial commitment (Scarpella et al. 2000 Development). From the characterized-marker survey.

WOX homeobox needed for trichomes on leaves and glumes (map-based cloning, RNAi; Li et al. 2012 Rice); no cell-resolution expression shown. Oryzabase symbol GL1 (synonyms OsWOX3B, NUDA). Candidate for Jing 2026 ST "Bract_hair" bins. From the characterized-marker survey.

Sucrose transporter for phloem (re)loading; promoter-GUS mainly in companion cells, protein in SE and CC of leaf, sheath and stem (Scofield et al. 2007 J Exp Bot). Not shown in the panicle, so medium. From the characterized-marker survey (also in rice_root.tsv context).
